rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-13: ONE knob changed vs the iter-6 hr-0.4222 PEAK base (image-domain SPATIAL bilateral sigma img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5, BOTH x and y together = the isotropic image-domain spatial-extent sigma); all 17 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_06.json (img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, proj_sr=0.02, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-6 hr 0.3330 / PSNR 20.18 / SSIM 0.7796). WHOLE PROJECTION DOMAIN NOW CLOSED -> PIVOT to the last untouched IMAGE-domain axis. Read iter-11->12 BY HEADROOM (campaign primary, PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo): iter-11 proj_sr 0.02->0.05 (LOOSEN proj RANGE) DEAD FLAT (hr 0.3330->0.33285, PSNR 20.18->20.181, SSIM 0.7796->0.7790); iter-12 proj_kernel 7->9 (proj SPATIAL extent) DEAD FLAT (hr 0.3330->0.33296, PSNR 20.18->20.1825, SSIM 0.7796->0.7796). So BOTH proj-domain axes (range AND spatial extent) are structurally inert on this 128-view phantom substrate -- the proj stack is fully in the symmetry trap; do NOT push proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf further (all wasted-param moves on the near-identity proj filter). FAILURE MODE being documented: hr~0.42 (seed-123 regime) / hr~0.333 (seed-42 regime) is the 6-param bilateral's structural noise-floor ceiling on the 64-view (half of 128) FBP -- it is IMAGE-DOMAIN-FBP-BOUNDED on this 128-view phantom substrate. EVERY image-domain CAPACITY/ANCHOR lever is exhausted: image-domain DEPTH (img_n_bf, hr slope collapsed to ~0 by n_bf=5: 1->3 +0.051, 3->5 +0.006, 5->7 +0.000), per-scan OPTIMIZER budget (n_iter flat 400->800; the 6-param BF physically CANNOT overfit one scan), warm-start anchor length (pretrain_epochs flat 3->6), seed (8->confirmed split-variance only), val_n (9->confirmed hr~0.41 real on seed-123). img_sr is EXHAUSTED + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction (demo wants LOOSE 0.02; tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- FORBIDDEN, do NOT tighten). The ONE genuinely-untried knob remaining in the LOOSE-img_sr regime is the image-domain SPATIAL sigma img_sx/img_sy -- pinned at 1.5/1.5 across ALL 12 prior iters, NEVER varied. img_sr (range) governs how much the image BF acts ACROSS intensity jumps (edge selectivity); img_sx/img_sy (spatial) govern the SPATIAL neighborhood over which it averages WITHIN an edge-bounded region -- a DISTINCT, orthogonal axis to range AND to depth. HYPOTHESIS (img-spatial): widening img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 enlarges the image-domain averaging neighborhood, giving each of the 7 image BFs a larger spatial support to smooth the broad post-FBP noise floor (the demo-relevant axis since hr here is PSNR/noise-sensitive) while staying edge-preserving via the unchanged LOOSE img_sr=0.02 -> may lift hr/PSNR above iter-6 ~0.333 / PSNR 20.18 on the SAME seed=42 split. Direction is WIDER (more smoothing of the noise floor), which is the demo-correct over-smoothing axis (demo wants MORE noise smoothing -- the whole img_n_bf depth arc earned hr by adding noise-smoothing capacity); the unchanged LOOSE img_sr keeps it from blurring across phantom edges. If hr/PSNR stay FLAT, it CLOSES the image-domain spatial-extent ceiling question: the 6-param bilateral is structurally inert on its spatial sigma too, confirming the ~hr 0.33 ceiling is the 64-view-FBP noise floor regardless of spatial support -- a clean ceiling-doc result toward iter-20. Chose img_sx/img_sy (image SPATIAL, the last untouched image-domain axis named in the steer) over (a) proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf (whole proj domain just confirmed flat at iter-11/12 -- symmetry trap, wasted), (b) img_sr (exhausted + WRONG-direction, FORBIDDEN), (c) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs/seed/val_n (all DEAD FLAT / variance-only, exhausted), (d) img_kernel (also untouched at 5, but img_kernel sets the discrete window SIZE while img_sx/sy set the continuous spatial sigma WITHIN that window -- sigma is the finer, more-informed lever and at kernel=5 a sigma of 2.5 is near the window edge, so vary sigma first; img_kernel is the iter-14 candidate if img_sx/sy moves hr), (e) grad_clip (mandatory 2304-view-adjoint overflow guard at 1.0 -- a stability guard, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-6 PEAK values: img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-6 ran 828 s, iter-11 ran 330 s, iter-12 similar; img_sx/img_sy are pure init sigma values inside the fixed img_kernel=5 window -> ZERO added compute, wall ~unchanged, comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized; do NOT tighten img_sr.
